name: hud_layout_base_destructor
description: HudLayoutBase::Destructor destroys the embedded base widget at offset 0x30 and then runs the base container cleanup path.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; the MSVC EH destructor frame is deferred to the HUD layout source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x40d3b0 show the MSVC destructor EH frame, HudUiWidget::DestructorCore on this+0x30, and then HudUiContainer::DestructorCore on this.

The native smoke invokes HudLayoutBase::Destructor on a layout with a constructed embedded widget and verifies the widget ftable resets to g_HudUiCommon_FTable; the enclosing container vptr is not asserted because the current HudUiContainer::DestructorCore source surface is a no-op.
